prompt.en: How long do the Prime Minister and the party in power stay in office?
prompt.fr: Combien de temps le premier ministre et le parti au pouvoir restent-ils en poste?

options.en: For a full four years, whatever the House of Commons votes.
options.fr: Pendant quatre années complètes, peu importe les votes de la Chambre des communes.

options.en: Until the Senate withdraws its support from the party in power.
options.fr: Jusqu'à ce que le Sénat retire son appui au parti au pouvoir.

options.en: As long as most members of the House of Commons support them.
options.fr: Tant que la majorité des députés de la Chambre des communes les appuient.

options.en: Until the Governor General's own five-year term comes to an end.
options.fr: Jusqu'à la fin du mandat de cinq ans du gouverneur général.

explanation.en: Support in the House is what keeps a government going. That support is called confidence, and it can be withdrawn at any time.
explanation.fr: C'est l'appui de la Chambre qui maintient un gouvernement en place. Cet appui s'appelle la confiance, et il peut être retiré à tout moment.

source.quote: The Prime Minister and the party in power run the government as long as they have the support or confidence of the majority of the MPs.

verification.evidence: The Prime Minister and the party in power run the government as long as they have the support or confidence of the majority of the MPs. When the House of Commons votes on a major issue such as the budget, this is considered a matter of confidence.
